title: Harmful Responses Are Jailbreak Templates: Transferring Autoregressive Jailbreaks to Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.31331v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible masked generation through bidirectional context modeling, but this capability also introduces a distinct jailbreak attack surface. We find that a harmful response to a given query naturally serves as an effective jailbreak template: simply masking a subset of its tokens can induce a dLLM to reconstruct harmful content. Based on this observation, we propose RMT-Jailbreak, a general framework that transfers existing autoregressive (AR) jailbreak attacks to dLLMs through their induced harmful responses. RMT-Jailbreak converts an AR-generated harmful response into a high-mask-ratio template using uniform token retention, and further applies prompt-based safety filtering to mask any remaining visible harmful content. The refined template is then provided to the target dLLM for bidirectional reconstruction. Extensive experiments across multiple AR jailbreak methods and target dLLMs demons

translated_title: 有害回复即越狱模板：将自回归越狱攻击迁移至扩散语言模型
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型通过双向上下文建模实现了灵活的掩码生成能力，但这一能力同时也引入了独特的越狱攻击面。我们发现，针对给定查询的有害回复天然可以充当有效的越狱模板：只需对其中的部分词元进行掩码处理，就能诱导扩散语言模型重构出有害内容。基于这一观察，我们提出了RMT-Jailbreak，这是一个通用框架，可以将现有的自回归（AR）越狱攻击通过其诱导生成的有害回复迁移到扩散语言模型上。RMT-Jailbreak采用均匀词元保留策略，将AR模型生成的有害回复转换为高掩码比例的模板，并进一步应用基于提示的安全过滤来掩码所有剩余可见的有害内容。精炼后的模板随后被提供给目标扩散语言模型进行双向重构。在多种AR越狱方法和目标扩散语言模型上开展的大量实验表明……
tldr: 本文发现有害回复经部分掩码后可天然充当越狱模板，并据此提出RMT-Jailbreak框架，将现有的自回归模型越狱攻击有效迁移到扩散语言模型上。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that harmful responses can naturally serve as effective jailbreak templates when partially masked, and proposes RMT-Jailbreak, a general framework that transfers existing autoregressive jailbreak attacks to diffusion language models.
